citationText: 10. In this case, all of the systems were baffled, thus diffraction off the edges of the boxes in this frequency range was obviated. It would be a problem if the loudspeakers were free-standing, as would also be the 4-π:2-π steradian baffle transition that affects both the direct soand and power response of freestanding loudspeakers.
